'''1999 Seattle Open''' was a Star Wars CCG open tournament held in Seattle, Washington in 1999. [[Charles Hickey]] posted the Hunt Down deck he played there; he says he lost one game, to a Harvest deck.<ref name="dt-912">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/912 Seattle Open Huntdown Deck], DeckTech (Charles "Teacher" Hickey, 18 October 1999). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/912/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/912/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 17 October 1999<ref name="tr-d82" />
* '''Site:''' Seattle, Washington
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
